Chandigarh is really three cities in one — Chandigarh itself (a Union Territory), Mohali in Punjab and Panchkula in Haryana — sharing one urban and industrial belt. That Tricity setup is exactly where a lot of buyers get confused, because a site in Mohali sits under a different administration from one in Panchkula. SAMAN handles the whole belt cleanly. As a Container Office Manufacturer for the Chandigarh Tricity, we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory, and this page covers what Tricity buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in the Chandigarh Tricity

IT and ITES campuses in Mohali use them as project and site-admin cabins during fit-out and expansion. Pharma and auto-ancillary units use them as supervisor and QC cabins. Government and institutional contractors across Chandigarh use them as documented site offices for public projects. Real-estate and infrastructure builders on the Zirakpur–Mohali–Panchkula growth corridor use them as construction site offices and security posts. The common need is a clean, well-finished unit, often with documentation for institutional onboarding.

Tricity industrial zones we deliver to

Because the Tricity spans three administrations, we note the state alongside each belt:

  • Chandigarh Industrial Area, Phase I & II (160002, Chandigarh UT) — light engineering, printing, service and IT-adjacent units; admin and project cabins.
  • Mohali Industrial Area / SAS Nagar (160055, Punjab) — IT/ITES, pharma and auto ancillaries; site-admin and supervisor cabins.
  • Panchkula Industrial Area, Phase 1 (134113, Haryana) — engineering, food processing and packaging; site and admin cabins.
  • Zirakpur–Mohali–Panchkula construction corridor — real-estate and infrastructure projects; site offices and security cabins.

Sites outside these pockets — IT City, Derabassi or along the Chandigarh–Ambala road — are also served; share the location and the administration (UT/Punjab/Haryana) when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in the Tricity
10 ft10 × 8 ftSecurity/gate cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, IT/site-admin cabin, documentation room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

For phased IT and institutional projects we can supply a modular shipping container office for staged projects. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Most Tricity orders are customised to the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation for IT and admin use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; a cleaner corporate finish for institutional and government sites; and ramps or external steps. Units can be a single relocatable office or a staged set for a growing campus. Tell us the team size, the administration your site falls under, and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in the Chandigarh Tricity

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to the Tricity by road, around 300 km via the Eastern Peripheral Expressway and NH-44 — a fast, well-established corridor. Transit is typically 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and a default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve container office builds across the Delhi belt on the same northern network, so the route to Chandigarh is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house and deal with the manufacturer directly, we can provide the certificates and documentation that institutional and government contractors need for onboarding. We supply across North India, including the Jaipur container office manufacturing page and container offices routed to Lucknow.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in the Chandigarh Tricity depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, finish level (institutional sites often want a cleaner look), partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, and transport. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size, finish and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

Does one quote cover Chandigarh, Mohali and Panchkula?

Yes. We supply across all three Tricity administrations from the same factory. Tell us which one your site falls under (Chandigarh UT, Mohali/Punjab or Panchkula/Haryana) and we confirm delivery and any local access details for that location.

Can you provide documents for government and institutional contractors?

Yes. As the manufacturer we can supply GST, ISO, NSIC and DPIIT documentation for vendor onboarding on institutional and government projects. Tell us what your tender or contractor process needs.

How long does delivery take to the Tricity?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, around 300 km away via the Eastern Peripheral Expressway and NH-44, with typical road transit of 3–5 days once the unit is built. We confirm the schedule at order stage based on your site and access.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Chandigarh, Mohali or Panchkula container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
